games.note: A duel between burnt orange and white squads in a big time September SEC battle.
Two SEC teams on the rise into the top 15 face off coming off big wins. Who can keep up with the big guys?
OU survived a scare from New Mexico. What will they do against an untested UGA?
Two of the Big Ten's best offensive options in Kamari Moulton and JJ Buchanan duel in the Big House.
Alabama has been a bit shaky this season so far. Can Sellers and Fuller knock them off.

One of the best rivalries in the modern SEC takes a more desparate turn this year. The Aggies and Tigers are both coming off upset losses. A two game losing streak before the calendar turns to October may spell doom for these playoff hopefuls.
A rebranded Pac-12 duel in the Big Ten sees two programs with a lot of pressure on them due to falling short.
Two underrated SEC squads face off in Starkville. Can Mizzou shut down Heisman sleeper Kamario Taylor?
